svg.aria-label: Agentic pipeline: input (query · webhook, REST · Zod) → router agent (LangChain, 10 intent types) → tool calls (text-to-SQL, RAG · search) → knowledge (graph · entities, vectors · Qdrant) → guardrails (SQL guard, auto-repair) → llm tier (Flash → Pro, Gemini · GPT) → result (streamed answer, SSE → Next.js). memory · Redis cache · pgvector embeddings. deploy Docker → Cloud Build → Cloud Run · secrets Secret Manager · ci GitHub Actions
